name: RC–B10–0157/2025 – After § 4 – Am 9
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for EU support towards a just transition and reconstruction in Syria
part_text: 4a. Deplores the illegalisation and persecution of Syrian democratic and secular forces, who were denied freedom of assembly and expression, had their assets confiscated and were unable to reorganise as political or social forces;
